system.description:
"I blinked once, then twice before realizing that I was still alive to blink and not buried miles below the surface. That’s when I heard it; Izumi was taking in short heavy breaths that sounded almost like she was wheezing. She had summoned an unbelievable amount of steel to stop the cavern from collapsing and saved us all. I started to let out my gratitude when she collapsed onto the ground. Sensei walked up to her and lifted her onto his back saying that he was proud to have such a strong student"

-Kamira Kaguya The Long Road, Ch. 24 excerpt

Tempered Will

The Konjiki is a clan from the village hidden in stones, a small village in the country between the lands of wind and earth, this clan is known for both their mercenary works in those great nations and their special affinity to the materialization of Yin and Earth chakra known as “Steel Release”.

Konjiki Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Con

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Crafting, Ninshou

Steel Release: You begin with the Earth Release Affinity.

Konjiki Techniques: The Konjiki Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Konjiki Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Liquid Metal: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one weapon (or a stack if they have the ammunition trait) with a bulk of 2. This weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for but dissolves if another weapon is conjured this way.

Konjiki Features

Alomancy

1st Level Clan Feature

Your clans Kekkei Genkai grants you unparallel control over the physical makeup of metals you infuse your chakra into, even able to liquify them to make it easier to reshape. Your clan has fostered a plethora of ways to utilize this Alomancy, which are represented as Liquid Metal Ingots, of which, you have an amount equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.

You can spend these Ingots to fuel your Alomancy. You begin with 1 Alomancy Technique of your choice. You gain an additional Alomancy Technique at 7th and 15th levels. If an Alomancy forces a saving throw, or requires an attack use your highest jutsu attack or saving throw to resolve its effect. You regain spent ingots when you complete a short rest.

Iron Bulwark

As a Reaction, to an allied creature within 30 feet of you taking damage you can spend 1 Ingot to project a metallic shield, intercepting damage, acting as a barrier for them. The barrier projected has hit points equal to 2d6 + 6 and DR equal to your highest ability modifier. Its hit points increase by +1d6 at 7th, and 15th levels. This barrier lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Steel Reinforcement

As a Bonus action, you can select one willing creature within 30 feet of you wearing armor or wielding a weapon, and wrap them in your metallic chakra, spending 2 Ingots. When you do, for the next minute their armor or weapons bulk is increased by either +2, +4 or +6, your choice. The chosen bulk increase also provides some benefits for the duration.

Bulk +2. The target gains the Fortified property and a +2 bonus to their Armor Bonus.

Bulk +4. Same as Bulk +2 & a +2 bonus to their Constitution Saving throws.

Bulk +6. Same as Bulk +2 and a +2 bonus to their Strength and Constitution Saving throws.

Metallic Thorns

As a Bonus action, by spending 1 ingot, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you, and fill a 10-foot cube with liquid metal that form into spike when a creature of your choice steps onto the space, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 piercing damage, gaining 2 ranks of Bleed and reducing their remaining movement by 15 on a failure, or half damage on a successful save. This trapped area lasts for 1 minute and can trigger once per turn.

This damage increases by 1d6 at 7th and 15th levels and the ranks of Bleed increases by +1 at 11th level.

Metallic Step

As a reaction, to seeing an allied creature other than yourself, within 60 feet of you be forced to make a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, by spending 1 ingot, you can form some of the metal on their person, into something that can pull them, dragging them up to 20-feet into a space closer to you, in a straight line without triggering opportunity attacks. If this movement would pull them out of the triggering effects range, they make their saving throw at advantage, otherwise, they gain a +2 bonus to their saving throw.

Superheavy Metals

As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu, you can spend up to four Ingots to magnify its weight, making it barrel through any defense. When you do, if the affected creature is Bruised, they suffer the effect of Bruised once additional time for each ingot spent.

Supersharp

As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu, you can spend up to two Ingots to magnify the piercing capabilities of the strike, gaining 4 Pierce for every ingot spent this way.

Metallic Fan

As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu that targets a single creature, you can spend one Ingot to magnify the striking range of the attack. All creatures within 5-Feet of the original target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the attacks original damage on a failure or no damage on a success. If this attack is a critical hit, all creatures making their saving throw make their save at disadvantage.

Metallurgy

3rd Level Clan Feature

Members of the Konjiki clan are able to utilize the malleability of their chakra, infusing it into metal, bending and twisting it into a liquid-like substance, capable of reclaiming a solid shape at the Konjiki’s pleasure. At the conclusion of a Short or long rest, the Konjiki can choose to create a Metallurgy Armor or coat a weapon they wield in Metallurgy itself, that lasts until they complete their next rest.

If a weapon, they select a single weapon they have in their possession to become coated in Metallurgy. If the weapon chosen has the Ammunition trait, treat the ammunition die as a d12 that can never be reduced in size by an effect that would call for it. The weapon gains a unique Konjiki weapon property from the following list.

Beginning at 11th level, you can create one of each an Armor and weapon.

Geometric Makeup. The Weapon grants you with a solid offense and defense with its dense structure, gaining the Fortified and Blocking 1 traits.

Counter weight. The weapon cannot be disarmed from you and gains the thrown (20/40) and Return keywords.

Shearing Edge. Once per turn, on a hit, you may reduce an affected creatures AC by 1, or their DR by 2, until the beginning of your next turn.

| #### Mercury Foundry / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / You generate +1 Ingot at the beginning of each of your turns. / You DR is set at 12. If your DR is instead higher than 12, increase your DR by +2. / At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain 8 Temporary hit points. / Weapons made by your Liquid Metal trait, or under the effects of your Metallurgy clan feature, count as any weapon group, for the purposes of casting Bukijutsu. / Armor made by Metallurgy can gain a second trait. |

Rebounding Line. Once per turn, if your attack using this weapon (Weapon attack or Taijutsu attack) result would be 5 or higher than the targets AC, the next attack targeting you before the beginning of your next turn is made at disadvantage.

If armor, select one Armor from the following: Reinforced Cloth, Shinobi Combat Jacket or Jonin Armor. The armor can be in any design of your choice, has a Bulk of 1 and gains a Konjiki unique armor property from the following list:

Anchored Greaves. You have Advantage on saves to resist being moved against your will. On a successful save against such an effect, you gain 1 Liquid Metal Ingot.

Elemental Deflection Plates. Select one elemental damage type (Earth, Wind, Fire, Cold, Lightning or Acid). You have resistance to the given damage type until you are hit by a critical hit or create another weapon or armor with this feature.

Expanding Plates. All other creatures within 5 feet of you gain a +2 bonus to their AC.

Smart Armor. While wearing this armor, you can use Intelligence, in place of Dexterity for armor class calculation and 60 feet of tremor sense.

Kinetic Raiment. Once per turn, when you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you gain a bonus to the damage you deal equal to twice your Reinforced value. When you use this effect, you gain 1 Liquid Metal Ingot.

Bromine Keys

7th Level Clan Feature

You take liquid metal and insert it into an open lock of a sealed or locked contraption. By spending 1 minute, you can perform the Pick Locks activity as if you have a Security Kit. When you do, reduce the DC by 10 as your try to reconfigure the locks internals to fit any key shape you are thinking. On a successful check, the lock is unlatched and any other key that would normally unlock the lock can no longer do so. Any key you have can now unlock or lock the lock as if it was the original key.

Heavy Metal

11th Level Clan Feature

You learn to infuse some of your metallic chakra into your earth release jutsu, reinforcing their molecular structure, making them harder, stronger, and more durable.

When you cast a Jutsu with the Earth Release keyword that summons a creature, structure, or barrier with hit points, it becomes suffused with your metallic chakra, enhancing it further. Increase the hit points it has at creation, by an amount equal to your level or you can increase the DR it has at creation for the duration of its existence by an amount equal to your highest ability modifier.

Liquid Mercury Foundry

15th Level Clan Feature

Konjiki’s ultimate form of Metallurgy, infusing liquid metal into your skin, granting you metal like resilience, but also the ability to manifest any tool needed to accomplish any task at hand.

As a Bonus action, you enter your Mercury Foundry state, coating yourself in liquid metal for the next minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a short rest.
